notes: §1985:VI.3.2.1.2 SR1: "The comment-entry may be any combination of the characters from the computer's character set. The continuation of the comment-entry by the use of the hyphen in the indicator area is not permitted; however, the comment-entry may be contained on one or more lines." The first and third requirements conform at 85 for the five paragraphs of the Identification Division structure (AUTHOR, INSTALLATION, DATE-WRITTEN, DATE-COMPILED, SECURITY): CommentEntryOf opens the paragraph at an Area-A word that CommentEntryParagraphs names inside an IDENTIFICATION DIVISION and keeps it open over every following line with no Area-A word; ConvertLine writes the header as the paragraph word and two periods (CommentEntryHeader) and discards each body line before the lexer reads it, so no character of the entry is ever scanned and the entry runs over as many lines as it likes (probed at 85: an apostrophe, an unclosed quotation mark, the words COPY and REPLACE, pseudo-text delimiters, PROCEDURE DIVISION, a comment line and a blank line inside the entry all compile). The text stage has no edition arm; the parser sees AUTHOR DOT DOT with no commentEntry, and the paragraph is refused from 2002 by its removal gate. The part not implemented is the prohibition: CommentEntryOf's first statement answers a continuation line (hyphen in the indicator area) inside an open comment-entry as one more body line, so a comment-entry continued with a hyphen is discarded as commentary and the program compiles with no diagnostic (AUTHOR, DATE-COMPILED and SECURITY probed). The witness runs an AUTHOR entry of odd characters over two lines. No kb/Work note has the defect.

next.reason: 1985: "The comment-entry may be any combination of the characters from the computer's character set."; 2023: "No comment-entry paragraphs (AUTHOR, DATE-WRITTEN, etc.) remain; the identification division rules cover only PROGRAM-ID". The 1985 comment-entry belongs to the obsolete optional Identification Division paragraphs. No 2023 candidate covers comment-entries, so 2023 lacks the feature.
